integrity: The proof is a modal polynomial calculation. The two-dimensional extremum follows from an exact weighted-average argument over the forced endpoint spectrum; the three-dimensional blow-up follows from the interior zero of the first-step polynomial. The packaged checker replays exact algebra and rational witnesses but is not used as a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the first two completed Heavy-Ball updates on exact SPD quadratics, classical spectral-endpoint parameters, and zero-velocity initialization. It does not assert divergence, does not cover arbitrary initial momentum or parameter choices, and the unbounded ratio is relative to the possibly tiny first-step objective rather than the initial objective.
title: Three dimensions are minimal for unbounded second-step Heavy-Ball objective spikes
